about: The assertion ledger's catalogue and resolver (docs/design/form-model.md). `predicates` states each predicate's
subject kind, the entity kinds and typed values its object may be, how many values a subject has in one scope,
and whether one claim may name alternatives. `resolve` is the SQL that turns a slot's claims into its
`current_claims` row; the Worker, the review service and the publication run it after a `WITH crop_now(unit,version)`
of their own, which names the current evidence version of the crops being resolved, and bind ?1 to a JSON array of
[subject, predicate, scope, slot] keys. Lines starting with -- are comments.

A `date_*` predicate dates a document: its value is a date as `glyph_atlas.dates` reads it ({of, text, start, end, precision, qualifier, uncertain, day, calendar, conversion, note}), and it lists no `values` because only a publication writes one, from a data/sources record (`scripts/export_dates_cloudflare.py`).

has_form.label: the form a crop's letterforms are written in
has_form.subject: crop

represented_by.label: a representation that names the form
represented_by.subject: form

date_composed.label: when the text a document carries was composed (成立)
date_composed.subject: document

date_copied.label: when this copy was written out (書写, 補写)
date_copied.subject: document

date_colophon.label: a date a colophon, preface or postface of this copy states (奥書, 識語, 序, 跋, 刊記)
date_colophon.subject: document

date_annotated.label: when reading marks were added (加点)
date_annotated.subject: document

date_printed.label: when this copy, or the work, was printed (刊行)
date_printed.subject: document

date_edition.label: a later impression or edition this copy is (後印, 再版)
date_edition.subject: document

date_exemplar.label: the date of the copy or edition this one reproduces (元奥書, 底本)
date_exemplar.subject: document

date_produced.label: the date the holder gives the item, without saying what it dates
date_produced.subject: document

date_other.label: another date a source gives, such as that of the content (内容年代)
date_other.subject: document

resolve: keys(subject,predicate,scope,slot) AS (
SELECT DISTINCT json_extract(value,'$[0]'),json_extract(value,'$[1]'),json_extract(value,'$[2]'),json_extract(value,'$[3]') FROM json_each(?1)),
-- A claim is live while nobody retracted it and its crop evidence is the crop's current version.
live AS (
SELECT a.id,a.subject,a.predicate,a.scope,a.slot,a.object,a.value,a.confidence,a.confidence_scheme,a.asserted_by,a.asserted_at,
coalesce(a.alternative_set,a.id) AS claim
FROM keys k JOIN assertions a ON a.subject=k.subject AND a.predicate=k.predicate AND a.scope=k.scope AND a.slot=k.slot
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assertion_actions x WHERE x.assertion=a.id AND x.action='retract')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM assertion_evidence e WHERE e.assertion=a.id AND e.kind='crop'
AND e.ref IS NOT (SELECT c.version FROM crop_now c WHERE c.unit=a.subject))),
-- Each person's latest accept or reject of each live claim; the asserter's own claim is their acceptance.
-- A verdict on one alternative of a set is a verdict on the set. Each claim's actions are read by its id;
-- actions made in the same millisecond count in the order they were written.
verdicts AS (
SELECT l.claim,x.actor,x.action,row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.claim,x.actor ORDER BY x.at DESC,x.rowid DESC) AS latest
FROM live l CROSS JOIN assertion_actions x ON x.assertion=l.id
WHERE x.action IN ('accept','reject') AND x.actor<>l.asserted_by),
-- A claim is one assertion, or the members of one alternative set together.
claims AS (
SELECT l.subject,l.predicate,l.scope,l.slot,l.claim,max(l.asserted_by) AS asserted_by,max(l.asserted_at) AS at,count(*) AS size,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT v.actor) FROM verdicts v WHERE v.claim=l.claim AND v.latest=1 AND v.action='accept') AS accepts,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT v.actor) FROM verdicts v WHERE v.claim=l.claim AND v.latest=1 AND v.action='reject') AS rejects,
(SELECT json_group_array(json(m.member)) FROM (SELECT json_object('assertion',i.id,'object',i.object,'value',json(i.value),
'confidence',i.confidence,'scheme',i.confidence_scheme) AS member FROM live i WHERE i.claim=l.claim ORDER BY i.object,i.value,i.id) m) AS members,
(SELECT json_group_array(json_array(m.object,m.value)) FROM (SELECT i.object,i.value FROM live i WHERE i.claim=l.claim ORDER BY i.object,i.value) m) AS vkey
FROM live l GROUP BY l.claim),
standing AS (SELECT * FROM claims WHERE 1+accepts>rejects),
-- The latest adjudication of a live claim decides its slot.
decided AS (
SELECT * FROM (SELECT l.subject,l.predicate,l.scope,l.slot,l.claim,
row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY l.subject,l.predicate,l.scope,l.slot ORDER BY x.at DESC,x.rowid DESC) AS latest
FROM live l CROSS JOIN assertion_actions x ON x.assertion=l.id WHERE x.action='adjudicate') WHERE latest=1),
-- What a slot stands on: its adjudicated claim, or else its standing claims when they all name one value.
current AS (
SELECT c.* FROM claims c JOIN decided d ON d.claim=c.claim
UNION ALL
SELECT s.* FROM standing s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decided d WHERE d.subject=s.subject AND d.predicate=s.predicate AND d.scope=s.scope AND d.slot=s.slot)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM standing o WHERE o.subject=s.subject AND o.predicate=s.predicate AND o.scope=s.scope AND o.slot=s.slot AND o.vkey<>s.vkey))
SELECT k.subject,k.predicate,k.scope,k.slot,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM decided d WHERE d.subject=k.subject AND d.predicate=k.predicate AND d.scope=k.scope AND d.slot=k.slot) THEN 'adjudicated'
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM current c WHERE c.subject=k.subject AND c.predicate=k.predicate AND c.scope=k.scope AND c.slot=k.slot)
THEN iif((SELECT max(c.accepts) FROM current c WHERE c.subject=k.subject AND c.predicate=k.predicate AND c.scope=k.scope AND c.slot=k.slot)>0,'accepted','asserted')
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM standing s WHERE s.subject=k.subject AND s.predicate=k.predicate AND s.scope=k.scope AND s.slot=k.slot) THEN 'disputed'
ELSE 'rejected' END AS status,
(SELECT i.object FROM current c JOIN live i ON i.claim=c.claim WHERE c.subject=k.subject AND c.predicate=k.predicate AND c.scope=k.scope AND c.slot=k.slot AND c.size=1 LIMIT 1) AS object,
(SELECT i.value FROM current c JOIN live i ON i.claim=c.claim WHERE c.subject=k.subject AND c.predicate=k.predicate AND c.scope=k.scope AND c.slot=k.slot AND c.size=1 LIMIT 1) AS value,
coalesce((SELECT c.members FROM current c WHERE c.subject=k.subject AND c.predicate=k.predicate AND c.scope=k.scope AND c.slot=k.slot ORDER BY c.at DESC,c.claim DESC LIMIT 1),'[]') AS members,
(SELECT json_group_array(s.id) FROM (SELECT i.id FROM current c JOIN live i ON i.claim=c.claim
WHERE c.subject=k.subject AND c.predicate=k.predicate AND c.scope=k.scope AND c.slot=k.slot ORDER BY i.asserted_at,i.id) s) AS supporting,
(SELECT json_group_array(json(s.summary)) FROM (SELECT json_object('claim',c.claim,'asserted_by',c.asserted_by,'at',c.at,'accepts',c.accepts,
'rejects',c.rejects,'standing',json(iif(1+c.accepts>c.rejects,'true','false')),'members',json(c.members)) AS summary
FROM claims c WHERE c.subject=k.subject AND c.predicate=k.predicate AND c.scope=k.scope AND c.slot=k.slot ORDER BY c.at,c.claim) s) AS claims,
(SELECT c.version FROM crop_now c WHERE c.unit=k.subject) AS crop_version,
'ledger-r1' AS resolver,
(SELECT max(t) FROM (SELECT a.asserted_at AS t FROM assertions a WHERE a.subject=k.subject AND a.predicate=k.predicate AND a.scope=k.scope AND a.slot=k.slot
UNION ALL SELECT x.at FROM assertion_actions x JOIN assertions a ON a.id=x.assertion
WHERE a.subject=k.subject AND a.predicate=k.predicate AND a.scope=k.scope AND a.slot=k.slot)) AS at
FROM keys k WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live l WHERE l.subject=k.subject AND l.predicate=k.predicate AND l.scope=k.scope AND l.slot=k.slot)
